name: Spiderman Push-Up
steps: Begin in a straight high-plank position on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and core braced.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest while bringing one knee outside your ribs toward the elbow on that side.
Press forcefully through your palms to return to the high plank while smoothly stepping your foot back to the starting position.
Alternate sides, bringing each knee toward the elbow on the same side.
tips: Keep your hips level and prevent your lower back from sagging as your knee pulls forward.
Keep your lifted foot hovering off the floor rather than dragging it along the ground.
